steps.text: Time - Unknown \ Weather - Unknown \ Visibility - Poor
Chernobog - Operation Squad E0's Location
Dr. {@nickname} Rescue Operation, Phase 3

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: We have less than an hour left. We can't afford to make a detour...

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: The more time we waste, the more like we are to get caught in the Catastrophe.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: We must directly cut across this area.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: However, we won't be able to conceal our movements anymore given the size of our forces.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: The possibility of getting ambushed when we're navigating through narrow streets is very high...

steps.name: Nearl
steps.text: What's the plan?

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: We don't have many options...

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: Dr. {@nickname}, what's your assessment?

options: All we have to do is destroy them in a head-on attack!
It takes time for the enemy to regroup.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: Reunion's forces are no match for us individually.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: But most of the time, they try to overwhelm us with sheer numbers.

steps.name: Nearl
steps.text: If we can utilize our speed to constantly press forward while avoiding large-scale fights...

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: They don't seem to have built any fortifications.

steps.name: Nearl
steps.text: If we're able to charge through their blockade...

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: Even though it looks like they have a numbers advantage, their loose formation won't be able to stop our advance.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: From what I've observed through our past battles, Reunion's communication methods are absolutely primitive.

steps.name: Nearl
steps.text: If we do this quickly, by the time they're able to regroup and mount an effort to stop us...

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: We'll already be long gone by the time they get into formation.

steps.name: Nearl
steps.text: Sounds good.

steps.name: Nearl
steps.text: We'll storm them, disrupt their formation, destroy their firebase, and then fall back quickly.

steps.name: Nearl
steps.text: Dobermann, are you testing me, or...

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: It's far easier to deal with threats we can see than to be stuck between a rock and a hard place.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: I take it that these are Dr. {@nickname}'s orders, Amiya?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: The situation is clear. I trust Doctor's decisions...

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: ...Trust isn't built so easily from just a single battle.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: I do think highly of Dr. {@nickname}, Amiya...

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: But don't let your guard down. Of course, there is nothing wrong with learning from the Doctor's wisdom, but remember, you can't fully rely on anyone else in this world.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: ...I know.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: Don't get me wrong, Doctor, I'm not trying to make things difficult for you.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: But I hope you understand... Amiya still needs to learn and grow.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: If you were in my position, you also wouldn't allow her to rely on someone else.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: However, know that I've already acknowledged your abilities as a commander.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: Also, there's no reason to be so formal. We're comrades-in-arms now.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: At least on the battlefield, I've already entrusted my life to you.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: Enough with the chit-chatting though, let's hurry it up.

steps.name: Nearl
steps.text: That's right.

steps.name: Nearl
steps.text: There's an old saying in Kazimierz: 'Death catches up to you when you stop to take a break.'
